auth.title: Welcome back
auth.subtitle: Sign in to keep your streak, rewards and progress safe.
auth.name: Your name
auth.phoneHelp: Optional. Add it and you can sign in with a one-time code (OTP) instead of a password.
auth.useOtp: Sign in with mobile OTP instead
auth.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
auth.otpHelp: The mobile number on your account. We'll text you a 6-digit code.
auth.otpExpiry: The code works once and expires in 5 minutes.
auth.otpDevHint: No SMS provider is configured, so the code is shown here instead of being texted. This never happens in production.
auth.otpCreateAccount: Create an account with this number
auth.otpCreateNotice: Create an account below — your mobile number is already filled in. After that you can sign in with an OTP.
auth.demoOtp: Or sign in with mobile OTP:

errors.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid email address.
errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.phoneTaken: That mobile number is already registered.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Please sign in instead.
errors.badCredentials: Wrong email or password. Please try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.resetInvalid: This reset link is no longer valid. Please ask for a new one.
errors.mailFailed: We couldn't send the email just now. Please try again shortly.
errors.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't go through. Please try again.
errors.passwordCommon: That password is too easy to guess. Please choose another.
errors.phoneUnknown: No account has this mobile number yet.
errors.otpRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from the text message.
errors.otpInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.smsFailed: We couldn't send the text message just now. Please try again shortly.

auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSentHint: The link works once and expires in 30 minutes. Check your spam folder too.
auth.resetBody: Pick something you'll remember. You'll be signed out everywhere else.
auth.resetDoneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
auth.resetExpiredBody: Reset links work once and last 30 minutes. Ask for a new one.
auth.signupSubtitle: Start your quit journey — track your progress, earn rewards, and get help the moment a craving hits.

onboarding.slide1Body: Small daily steps, real rewards, and support the moment a craving hits.
onboarding.slide2Body: Earn a free dental check-up, a care kit and more as you stay tobacco-free.
onboarding.slide3Body: Your progress stays on your phone. Your account only carries your sign-in — nothing else leaves the device.
onboarding.formSub: Your answers shape your plan and your very first badge.

timeToFirst.label: How soon after waking do you first use tobacco?

perDay.label: About how many cigarettes or bidis a day?

cansPerWeek.label: About how many pouches or tins a week?

hateFirst.label: Would the first use of the day be the hardest to give up?

difficultRefraining.label: Is it hard to hold back where tobacco isn't allowed — a temple, hospital or bus?

swallowJuice.label: Do you swallow the tobacco juice?

moreInMorning.label: Do you use more in the first hours after waking?

whenIll.label: Do you use even when you're ill in bed most of the day?

years.label: How many years have you used tobacco?

spend.label: How much do you spend a day?
spend.hint: In rupees (₹). A rough number is fine.

attempts.label: How many times have you tried to quit before?

motivation.label: How ready are you to quit right now?

triggers.label: What makes you want to use? Pick any that fit.
triggers.sub: We'll use these to build your plan.

badge.firstRewardNote: Your first reward — earned in your very first minute.
badge.alreadyThere: You've met every step — keep going to hold it!

dashboard.reportsSub: New reports and images are waiting for you

rewards.title: Your rewards
rewards.subtitle: Real rewards for real progress.
rewards.emptySub: Finish your first tobacco-free day to unlock your first scratch card.
rewards.needsList: To unlock this real reward, you still need:
rewards.claimAt: Show this code at a partner clinic to claim. Bring a photo ID.
rewards.shareText: I've earned {{reward}} on my tobacco-free journey — {{days}} days and counting! 🌱

day1.title: First day free
day1.detail: You made it through day one — the hardest step.

day3.title: 72 hours
day3.detail: Nicotine is leaving your body. Cravings ease from here.

day7.title: One week — certificate
day7.detail: A shareable certificate for your first tobacco-free week.

day15.title: Free dental check-up
day15.detail: A free oral-health check-up at a partner clinic.

day30.title: Oral-care voucher + Gold
day30.detail: A voucher toward oral-care products, and your Gold tier.

day90.title: Toothpaste + toothbrush kit
day90.detail: A free oral-care kit from a partner brand.

day180.title: Dental cleaning + Platinum
day180.detail: A professional cleaning, and your Platinum tier.

day365.title: Full dental exam + Diamond
day365.detail: A full exam, Diamond tier, and a 1-year certificate.

rewards.activeDaysNote: Rewards count the days you actually open the app, not days on the calendar.

checkin.title: Today's check-in
checkin.sub: Under 10 seconds. This is your data spine.
checkin.craving: How strong are your cravings today?
checkin.savedBody: Small daily steps add up. See you tomorrow.
checkin.slipBody: A slip is not failure. Your earned rewards and your total tobacco-free days all stay. Let's keep going from here.

sos.title: You've got this
sos.surfSub: Cravings peak and pass in a few minutes. Let's ride this one out together.
sos.madeItBody: The craving passed and you stayed strong. Here's where to go next.
sos.breatheSub: Follow the circle. In for 4, hold for 7, out for 8.

learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: Short lessons and videos. We track what you finish.
learn.demoPlayer: Demo player — stands in for a real lesson video

help.title: Help & support
help.sub: You're not alone. Reach out any time.
help.quitlineNote: Free counselling from trained counsellors, in many Indian languages.
help.emailNote: We usually reply within a couple of days.
help.placeholderNote: Support email and phone are placeholders for now.
help.emergency: For a medical emergency, contact your local emergency services.

progress.title: Progress
progress.insightNeed: Keep checking in — after about a week we'll spot your craving pattern.
progress.slipBody: It's not failure. Log it and keep your streak history and rewards.

plan.title: Your quit plan
plan.habitWater: Drink a glass of water when a craving hits
plan.habitWalk: Take a short walk after meals
plan.habitBrush: Brush your teeth morning and night

profile.title: Profile
profile.privacyBody: Your quit data — check-ins, streak and rewards — is backed up to your account so it survives a lost phone. Reports from your clinic stay on the server and are only fetched when you open them.
profile.supporterBody: Send your progress to family — social support really helps.
profile.saveBody: Add your name so it's yours. Everything still stays on this device.
profile.clearBody: This erases your journey on this device. It can't be undone.
profile.deleteAccountBody: This permanently removes your email, mobile number and password from our servers, and clears this phone. It cannot be undone.
profile.patientIdHelp: Show this at the clinic so they can find your record and send you reports.
profile.themeHelp: Light or dark — or let the phone decide.
profile.retakeHelp: Answer the intake questions again. Your streak and rewards are kept.

supporter.title: {{name}} is on a quit journey
supporter.body: Your encouragement makes a real difference. A kind message can be the reason someone keeps going.
supporter.encourageText: So proud of you! {{days}} days tobacco-free is amazing. Keep going — I'm with you 💪
supporter.shareLinkText: Follow my quit journey and cheer me on 🌱

reports.title: My reports
reports.sub: Reports, images and documents your clinic has sent you.
reports.emptySub: When your clinic sends a report or an image, it appears here. Show your Patient ID at the clinic so they can find you.
reports.privacy: Only you and your clinic can see these. They are never stored on this phone.
